candidates.description: This vector activates on common coordinating conjunctions and connector words across multiple languages, particularly focusing on terms equivalent to "and" or "or."
This vector represents Thai language subword and character n-gram prefixes.
This vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant character 'ต' (to).
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai vowel sign Sara I (ี) and related Thai character sequences.
This vector activates strongly for common Thai syllable components, prefixes, and character sequences.
These tokens represent character sequences containing the Thai consonant 'ว' (wo waen), often combined with various vowel signs and tone marks.
This vector represents audiovisual entertainment media, specifically film, television, and related visual formats.
This vector activates for mixed-script subword tokens and fragments spanning multiple non-Latin and Latin writing systems.
This vector represents the name and associated terms of the character Payne from the video game franchise *Max Payne*.
This feature vector activates on common Thai noun-forming prefixes, specific Thai substrings, and isolated English proper nouns or subwords.
